node_types: SEARCH i1 USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_formdev_record_index_1 (record_id=? AND field_id=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
main.sql: SELECT r.record_id, r.schema_version, r.data, r.ingested_at, page.ok AS order_value FROM (SELECT k.record_id AS rid, k.ingest_seq AS ok FROM formdev_record k WHERE k.form_id = ? AND k.status <> 'deleted' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM formdev_record_index i1 WHERE i1.record_id = k.record_id AND i1.form_id = ? AND i1.status <> 'deleted' AND i1.field_id = ? AND i1.value_num >= ? AND i1.value_num <= ?) ORDER BY k.ingest_seq DESC LIMIT ?) page JOIN formdev_record r ON r.record_id = page.rid ORDER BY page.ok DESC
